content.short: PropellerSwap builds solvers to help users and dApps execute trades at the best price.
content.description: Users often struggle to compare token swap prices across multiple platforms to find the best deal. PropellerSwap aggregates liquidity from both on-chain and off-chain sources, routes trades to secure favorable prices, and shields them from MEV to increase the likelihood of a successful swap. The process is streamlined by a clear, user-friendly front end that presents quotes, routes, and expected outcomes in one view. DApps can integrate the solver API by following the comprehensive documentation.
content.meta: PropellerSwap focuses on building solvers for users and dApps to execute their trades at the best price possible. Discover PropellerSwap and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Launching Fynd: An Open-Source Trustless DEX Router
resources.tldr: Run your own trustless DEX router locally: 10ms quotes, scaling to 1,000 requests per second, first self-routed swap in about five minutes. Aimed squarely at Ethereum developers.

resources.title: Track Onchain Liquidity Locally
resources.tldr: Risk managers, protocol teams, traders and investors all watch liquidity depth for different reasons. Sets out those reasons, then why tracking it locally beats querying constantly.

resources.title: Reducing Gas on the Tycho Router by 20%
resources.tldr: Tokens used to return to the router between every hop; now they flow straight through, cutting swap cost by up to 20%. Encoding also moved so you supply the critical parameters yourself.
